blogs.title: Beyond the Prompt: Why Your AI Art Is Still Guessing What You Want
blogs.description: An exploration of the limitations of current text-to-image models like Stable Diffusion. This post explains why prompts often lead to vague results and introduces the concept of 'subject-driven generation,' allowing artists to teach a model specific concepts (like a custom character style) using just a few reference photos.

blogs.title: The Secret Geometry of Neural Networks: A New Way to Fine-tune Models
blogs.description: A deep dive into the mathematical insight behind Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT). We break down how researchers discovered that preserving the 'angles' between neurons in a machine learning model is key to keeping its artistic skills intact while teaching it new tricks, avoiding common issues like model collapse.

blogs.title: ControlNet vs. The New Guard: Controlling Images Without Extra Code
blogs.description: Comparing traditional control methods (like ControlNet) with the emerging OFT framework. Learn how OFT achieves precise image control using segmentation maps or sketches but offers a revolutionary benefit: it doesn't require adding extra layers or steps to your existing workflow, making deployment faster and more efficient.
